module.Title: Label the Foundry Systems
module.Teaching: std::string stores text. Text values go inside quotation marks, and std:: identifies the string type from the standard library.
module.PredictionQuestion: Why does Forge Core need quotation marks?
module.PredictionExplanation: Quotation marks tell C++ that the characters form a string literal.
module.DebugPrompt: Use std::string and place the text value inside quotation marks.
module.RecallPrompt: Create the exact std::string variable systemName with the value Forge Core.
module.TransferPrompt: Create the exact std::string variable subsystemName with the value Turbine Bank.
module.PreviewMessage: The foundry now displays readable names for its systems.
